name: Ghostfolio-Desktop-Self-Hosted-Dashboard
description: Deploy a privacy-first Ghostfolio dashboard on your own hardware for effortless tracking of stocks, ETFs, crypto, and net worth.

paragraphs: Ghostfolio-Desktop-Self-Hosted-Dashboard is a privacy-first investment tracker that brings all your financial data into one clean, beautiful dashboard. Think of it as your personal financial mission control - you can see your stocks, bonds, crypto, and other assets all in one place, without ever sending your data to third-party servers.
Everything stays on YOUR computer. No cloud accounts, no data sharing, no tracking. Just you and your numbers.
features: Complete Investment Overview - Monitor your entire portfolio at a glance with clear charts and graphs
Asset Allocation Analysis - See exactly how your money is distributed across different asset classes
Real-Time Financial Analytics - Track performance metrics, gains, losses, and trends automatically
100% Privacy Focused - Your financial data never leaves your device
Self-Hosted Solution - Full control over your data and how it's used

whatItDoes.text: Ghostfolio-Desktop-Self-Hosted-Dashboard is a privacy-first investment tracker that brings all your financial data into one clean, beautiful dashboard. Think of it as your personal financial mission control - you can see your stocks, bonds, crypto, and other assets all in one place, without ever sending your data to third-party servers.

requirements.text: Automate Your Tracking: Set up an automated import from your brokerage accounts using CSV files (check your broker's export options).
